$Comment: The Great Turkey on the hard way in, the form its hard fight (EncounterManager/Harvest_Feast/Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Encounter_Hard.json) raises from Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Hard_Marker once the waves of hard Turkey Souls are down: Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey written out again, as the game writes its own hard bosses, with more health, the hard look (Models/Harvest_Feast/NPC/Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_HM.json, the same bird burning a hot orange) and the hard name, and the Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Hard_Mode effect beside the souls' sheen in _CombatConfig, which makes every peck hit harder. Its fight adds one hard health step per player beyond the first (the Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Hard_Scale_Health effects) and puts its fury on it at a fifth, on top of the hard mode, so MaxHealth here is its health for a player alone. It is in Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_Group, which both its fights bind and clear, and in no group Martha's favor counts. Melee_Damage's BaseDamage is one peck before armour and before the hard mode. Any key the template does not declare makes the game refuse the whole role.
